# Version 4.152.0
> **Skia m152 preview** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.152.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.200/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.152.0 previews Skia m152 with Graphite bindings and asynchronous pixel readback. It improves resource safety, adds Vulkan Silk.NET package support, and broadens native assets across supported platforms.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated through m152 servicing** — Carries the m152 engine update and subsequent servicing fixes. ([#4651](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4651), [#4808](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4808), [#4925](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4925))

## API Surface

- **Graphite and asynchronous pixel readback APIs added** — Adds Graphite backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn, plus backend-neutral asynchronous pixel readback on images and surfaces. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3968](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3968), [#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545))

## Bug Fixes

- **Native lifetime fixes prevent use-after-free conditions** — Roots pixel and region sources correctly and releases failed raster-image allocations and HarfBuzz stream assets. ([#4355](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4355), [#4558](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4558), [#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455), [#4710](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4710), [#4783](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4783))

## Platform

- **Native package coverage expanded** — Restores the Vulkan Silk.NET package, adds Apple symbols, and provides FreeType-backed font support on Nano Server. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527), [#4841](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4841), [#4846](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4846), [#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.200

Improves HarfBuzz shaping allocation behavior and stream lifetime handling while updating package and platform delivery.
